ios.desc:
Barqly Food makes it easy to order food, groceries, and everyday essentials from nearby restaurants and stores.

Browse local vendors, explore menus, add items to your cart, and place orders in just a few steps. Track your order in real time, get delivery updates, and manage your addresses and account details directly in the app.

With Barqly Food, you can:
• Discover nearby restaurants and stores
• Order meals, groceries, and daily essentials
• Save delivery addresses for faster checkout
• Pay using available payment options at checkout
• Track your order status from confirmation to delivery
• View order history and reorder with ease
• Contact support when you need help

Barqly Food is designed to give customers a smooth ordering experience, clear delivery visibility, and convenient access to local vendors in one app.

quotes.text:
I’ve been building software for the last few years, mostly working directly on products rather than just doing small freelance tasks.

Web apps, mobile apps, backend systems, payments, real-time systems, admin panels, deployments, the whole thing. Some of the products I’ve worked on are already live.

But honestly, right now things are a little quiet. I don’t have any active client work, and I’m looking for the next thing to work on.

So if anyone here has a project that needs a developer, needs help finishing something, or knows someone looking for a Software Engineer / Full Stack Developer, I’d genuinely appreciate you reaching out.

I’m comfortable taking something from an existing codebase and fixing/building it, or starting something from scratch.

Some of my work (https://vijeetshah.com/):

WorkUnion https://workunion.in/ https://apps.apple.com/us/app/workunion-hire-manage/id6781408717 https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.workunion.app&hl=en_IN
